items.title: Check the kiln elements
steps: Switch the kiln off at the wall and let it cool below 50 degrees.
Look at each element for blisters or sagging coils.
Note any fault in the kiln log and tell the studio lead before the next firing.

items.title: Sieve the glaze buckets
steps: Stir from the bottom until no sediment is left.
Pour through an 80-mesh sieve into a clean bucket.
Check the specific gravity: 1.45 for most glazes.

items.title: Replace the studio filter
steps: Order the filter by the 20th of the month before.
Swap it with the extraction fan off.
Write the date on the new filter frame.

items.title: Test the emergency shutoff
steps: Run the kiln at low power.
Press the shutoff and check the power drops.

letters.title: From the clay supplier, 12 October
body: Your order of 100 kg porcelain ships on Monday. The batch has a slightly higher iron content than usual, so expect a warmer white.
If the colour is outside what you need, tell us within seven days.

letters.title: From the market organiser, 15 October
body: Your stall is confirmed for the first Saturday of November. Setup opens at 7:00 and the hall closes at 17:00.

clauses.norm: Every kiln firing is logged before the kiln is switched on.
clauses.title: Reasoning

fields.label: Why
fields.text: A missing log hides a problem until a whole load is lost.

fields.label: Prevents
fields.text: Repeating a schedule that already failed.

fields.label: In practice
fields.text: Fill in clay, glaze, cone and start time on the sheet by the door.

clauses.norm: Glaze buckets are labelled with the recipe and the date mixed.
clauses.title: Reasoning

fields.label: Why
fields.text: Two white glazes look the same wet and fire very differently.

fields.label: Prevents
fields.text: Using the wrong glaze on a finished order.
